query:
UPDATE clients c
JOIN departments dept ON c.departmentId = dept.id
JOIN divisions div ON dept.divisionId = div.id
SET c.companyId = div.companyId,
    c.divisionId = dept.divisionId
WHERE c.companyId IS NULL OR c.divisionId IS NULL;
